faq_heading: Questions people ask about getting cited by ChatGPT

faqs.q: Can you pay to be cited by ChatGPT?
faqs.a: No. There is no paid placement inside ChatGPT's answers. Citations come from pages the assistant can find and trust, so the work is making your pages clear, factual and easy to find through search.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get cited by ChatGPT?
faqs.a: There is no fixed time. Pages usually need to be indexed and to rank first, which takes weeks. Treat it as a steady, long-term job, not a one-month project.

faqs.q: Does ranking on Google help me get cited by ChatGPT?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. AI assistants that search the web tend to pull from pages that already rank well, so good SEO is the base of AI visibility. Direct answers and clear structure then make a page easier to quote.

faqs.q: How do I check whether ChatGPT mentions my company?
faqs.a: Keep a fixed list of 10 to 20 buyer questions. Ask them in a fresh, logged-out window each week and note which companies are named and which pages are cited. Search Console does not show this traffic.

faqs.q: Do I need a different page for every AI assistant?
faqs.a: No. One strong page that answers a buyer question directly works across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google. Write for the buyer's question, not for a single tool.
